headline: Hospitality thinking that goes beyond the dining room — concept, operations and the experience between them.
situation: Misu is a restaurant and bar in Goa operating in a competitive market. The challenge was not just marketing, but the fundamentals of the hospitality business — concept, operations and experience.
challenge: Build a hospitality business that is profitable, consistent and memorable — not just a venue that looks good on social media.
thinking: We started with the operational fundamentals: menu engineering, food cost, service systems and kitchen control. Digital and creative work followed, grounded in a business that actually works.

workstreams.title: Concept & menu
workstreams.body: Refining the menu, pricing and product mix to align with the target audience and operational capacity.

workstreams.title: Operational systems
workstreams.body: SOPs, kitchen control, staffing and service systems that make the business predictable and scalable.

workstreams.title: Digital presence
workstreams.body: Social media, content and campaigns that reflect the actual experience, not an aspirational version of it.

proof: A hospitality business with stronger fundamentals, clearer positioning and a digital presence that reflects the actual guest experience.
